description: The demons have captured the princess and imprisoned her in the bottom-right corner of a dungeon. The knight starts at the top-left corner and can only move right or down. Each room has an integer representing health gained or lost. Determine the minimum initial health needed so the knight can rescue the princess (health must stay >= 1 at all times).
intuition: Work backwards from the princess to the start. At each cell, the knight needs enough health to survive the current cell and still have enough for the best path forward. The minimum health is max(1, future_need - current_cell), ensuring health never drops below 1.
approach: Use bottom-up DP starting from the princess cell. dp[i][j] = minimum health needed when entering cell (i,j). dp[i][j] = max(1, min(dp[i+1][j], dp[i][j+1]) - dungeon[i][j]).
jsWalkthrough:
Input: dungeon = [[-2,-3,3],[-5,-10,1],[10,30,-5]]

rows=3, cols=3
Initialize: dp[3][2]=1, dp[2][3]=1, all others=Infinity

Fill bottom-up:
i=2, j=2 (cell=dungeon[2][2]=-5):
  healthAfter = min(dp[3][2], dp[2][3]) = min(1, 1) = 1
  healthBefore = 1 - (-5) = 6
  dp[2][2] = max(6, 1) = 6

i=2, j=1 (cell=30):
  healthAfter = min(dp[3][1], dp[2][2]) = min(Inf, 6) = 6
  healthBefore = 6 - 30 = -24
  dp[2][1] = max(-24, 1) = 1

i=2, j=0 (cell=10):
  healthAfter = min(dp[3][0], dp[2][1]) = min(Inf, 1) = 1
  healthBefore = 1 - 10 = -9
  dp[2][0] = max(-9, 1) = 1

i=1, j=2 (cell=1):
  healthAfter = min(dp[2][2], dp[1][3]) = min(6, Inf) = 6
  dp[1][2] = max(6-1, 1) = 5

i=1, j=1 (cell=-10):
  healthAfter = min(dp[2][1], dp[1][2]) = min(1, 5) = 1
  dp[1][1] = max(1-(-10), 1) = 11

i=1, j=0 (cell=-5):
  healthAfter = min(dp[2][0], dp[1][1]) = min(1, 11) = 1
  dp[1][0] = max(1-(-5), 1) = 6

i=0, j=2 (cell=3):
  healthAfter = min(dp[1][2], dp[0][3]) = min(5, Inf) = 5
  dp[0][2] = max(5-3, 1) = 2

i=0, j=1 (cell=-3):
  healthAfter = min(dp[1][1], dp[0][2]) = min(11, 2) = 2
  dp[0][1] = max(2-(-3), 1) = 5

i=0, j=0 (cell=-2):
  healthAfter = min(dp[1][0], dp[0][1]) = min(6, 5) = 5
  dp[0][0] = max(5-(-2), 1) = 7

Output: dp[0][0] = 7
explanation:
1. Work backwards from the bottom-right corner.
2. dp[i][j] = minimum health needed entering cell (i,j).
3. To survive cell (i,j), need at least min(right, down) - dungeon[i][j] health.
4. Health must be at least 1 at all times, so take max with 1.
5. dp[0][0] is the answer.
hints: Forward DP is tricky because health and path sum both matter.
Work backwards: determine minimum health needed at each cell.
Health must always be >= 1, so clamp with max(_, 1).
